parts.label: b

parts.reason: S5.1 explicitly excludes calculation of correlation coefficients using the formula; here Sxy/sqrt(SxxSyy) formula is required, which is out.

parts.label: c
parts.technique: Interpretation of correlation coefficient
parts.reason: Depends on the out-of-spec calculated PMCC value from (b); interpreting r is discussed in S2.2/S5.1 but the specific calculation is excluded, and this part uses that answer.

parts.label: d
parts.technique: Effect of scaling on Sxx
parts.reason: Uses coding/scaling of summary statistics, covered under S2.3 coding guidance.

parts.label: e
parts.technique: Effect of scaling on correlation coefficient
parts.reason: Depends on the excluded PMCC calculation of part (b) as the base value; also correlation coefficient calculation formula is excluded under S5.1.

parts.label: a
parts.technique: Calculating Sfh summary statistic
parts.reason: Basic summary statistic calculation, covered by S2.3-style calculations, though used for regression it's just a sum calculation not the regression line itself.

parts.label: b
parts.technique: Calculating regression line equation
parts.reason: S2.2 explicitly excludes calculations involving regression lines; finding the line of regression a and b values is precisely such a calculation.

parts.label: c
parts.technique: Using regression equation to estimate value
parts.reason: Uses the regression line equation calculated in (b), which is out of spec (S2.2 exclusion), and depends on excluded prior part.

parts.label: d
parts.technique: Reliability of regression estimate (interpolation/extrapolation)
parts.reason: Although interpolation/extrapolation reliability is discussed generally in S2.2 guidance, this part directly depends on the excluded regression calculation in (b)/(c).

parts.label: e
parts.technique: Reasoning about applicability of regression model to different population
parts.reason: Depends on the excluded regression equation context; part only makes sense after out-of-spec regression calculation.

parts.label: a
parts.technique: Finding probability from sum=1 in discrete distribution
parts.reason: Basic discrete probability distribution work, covered by S4.1 (not mean/variance).

parts.label: b
parts.technique: E(S) calculation for discrete random variable
parts.reason: S4.1 explicitly excludes calculation of mean of discrete random variables.

parts.label: c
parts.technique: E(S^2) calculation for discrete random variable
parts.reason: S4.1 exclusion covers mean/variance calculation of discrete random variables; E(S^2) is part of variance calculation, so excluded.

parts.label: d
parts.technique: Var(S) calculation for discrete random variable
parts.reason: S4.1 explicitly excludes calculation of variance of discrete random variables.

parts.label: e
parts.technique: Probability of specific independent event sequences
parts.reason: This calculates P(5 and 5) using independence of successive spins (S3.1), a pure probability calculation not mean/variance; it does not depend on the excluded E(S)/Var(S) parts (b)-(d), since it only uses the individual probability P(S=5)=0.2 given in the table.

parts.label: f
parts.technique: Probability of game outcome after several spins using independence
parts.reason: Uses independence and combinations of individual spin probabilities (S3.1), does not require the excluded mean/variance results from (b)-(d).

parts.label: g
parts.technique: Probability of game outcome after several spins using independence
parts.reason: Same as (f): pure probability calculation using independent event probabilities, covered by S3.1, independent of excluded mean/variance parts.
